name: Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq: evolve 5 qubits with 3 layers of random
task_prompt: Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq: evolve 5 qubits with 3 layers of random rotations U, apply U^dagger, and verify the system returns to |0...0> with probability 1; then perturb one angle by 0.19 and report the echo decay. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
